text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, visiting nurse's office...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Nnh... Yaaawn...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Was I sleeping...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! It's already this late!?
W-W-What is meaning of this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You took tablet I gave you
and fell asleep.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Woke earlier than anticipated,
though—fumu.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Skin tone, eye sparkle, posture...
All excellent. Experiment success!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
E-Experiment? Thought what I took
was new nutritional supplement...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. New type.
Formulated by me, of course.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Greater subject's fatigue, deeper, healthier
sleep it induces... Ultimate nutritional supplement!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Excluding mice,
you were first subject...
Yes, consider it great success.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No way! Still had so much
to get done today...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Even while blatantly overworked?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That's...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
B-But...
Must work harder!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, hold on.
Heard interesting phrase other day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Even if routes differ,
all climb same mountain called physical training."
...Was that it, fufufu?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Comparing training to mountain climbing...
Quite good idea, really.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Destination, route selection, gear, companions,
grasping body condition and environment... truly similar!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, no matter how thorough preparations are,
what happens if one climbs without taking breaks?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's...
You'd get stranded... for sure.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! Resting well
leads directly to building superior body, you see.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Resting well, huh...
Understood, Tachyon-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'll make sure
to take proper breaks into consideration!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes. Setting that aside for moment,
preparations on my end are complete.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Preparations?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's call what gave you earlier 'Pill A'.
And what about to inject right now is... 'Liquid B'!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Using Pill A's lingering components inside you as catalyst,
it will grant further recovery! To you! Magnificent experiment!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No no no! Don't need that!
I've rested plenty already!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying? If we don't inject Liquid B,
Pill A's components will explode inside your body!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No way!? Th-That's a lie, right!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Indeed, total falsehood. Simply to distract your attention.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: See? Injection is already over.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Really... getting... so sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Truth is, merely poked your arm
lightly with fingernail, fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good night, Scarlet-kun.
Rest well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All more reason if so exhausted
as to fall asleep from mere placebo effect.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Experiment volunteer?
Do you want to rest too, over there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Panicked and ran away immediately.
